title: Banco Master Scandal Injects Chaos into Brazil's Presidential Race
detail: Al Jazeera's longform investigation reveals the Banco Master financial scandal is reshaping political alignments ahead of Brazil's election cycle, adding to existing tensions between Lula and Bolsonarista forces. The scandal has become a major disruptive factor in the 2026 presidential race.

media.caption: Banco Master scandal reshaping Brazil's 2026 presidential race

title: Datafolha MG: Lula Leads Flávio Bolsonaro 42%–36% in Minas Gerais
detail: A Datafolha poll in Minas Gerais, Brazil's second most populous state, shows Lula ahead at 42% versus Flávio Bolsonaro at 36%, marking a competitive race in a key electoral battleground ahead of the 2026 presidential election.

title: Datafolha PE: Lula Dominates at 61% in Pernambuco, Flávio Bolsonaro at 25%
detail: A Datafolha poll in Pernambuco shows Lula commanding 61% of voter support versus Flávio Bolsonaro at 25%, reflecting the PT's historically strong base in Brazil's Northeast region ahead of the 2026 presidential election.

title: Datafolha SP: Flávio Bolsonaro Edges Lula 39%–38% in São Paulo — Near-Tie in Brazil's Largest State
detail: A Datafolha poll in São Paulo shows Flávio Bolsonaro narrowly ahead at 39% versus Lula at 38%, with Cury at 5%, Caiado at 4%, and Renan at 4%. The near-tie in Brazil's most electorally decisive state signals a highly competitive 2026 presidential race.
